title: King Tide Fishing Charters
specs: Fast access to fishing grounds within 10 minutes from private dock
Targets salmon, halibut, lingcod, rockfish in Juan de Fuca Strait
Vessels Transport Canada certified with heated cabins and marine toilets on larger boats
Transport Canada Master Certification and Marine First Aid held by all captains
Fleet accommodates groups up to 18 guests with multi-boat coordination for large parties
includes: All necessary fishing equipment and tackle including premium rods, Islander reels, and Scotty downriggers
Catch cleaning, professional filleting, and heavy-duty bagging at private dockside cleaning station
On-board private marine toilets and fully enclosed heated cabins on 24' River Hawk and 28' Northwest vessels
Use of elite technology like Lowrance ActiveTarget HD Sonar
blurb: King Tide Fishing Charters offers half-day, full-day, multi-day, and dusk fishing charters targeting salmon, halibut, lingcod, and rockfish. Trips depart from a private dock in Sooke, BC, with fast access to local fishing grounds. They also offer wildlife and coastal explorer charters for families and photographers.
extraNote: 15% deposit required to secure booking, balance due on day of expedition · Cancellations free up to 3 days prior for 22' Whaler and 24' River Hawk, 7 days prior for 28' Northwest; later cancellations forfeit deposit · Weather cancellations at Captain's discretion with full refund or reschedule option · Captain may terminate charter without refund for intoxication or unsafe behavior · No catch guarantee; maximum effort and professional execution guaranteed · Private dock in Sooke, BC · April through December (varies by vessel and trip)

quotes.author: Allison J
quotes.text: What an unforgettable experience with King Tide Fishing Charters! Captain Andrew was incredibly patient, knowledgeable, and made sure the vibes were perfect the whole trip. This was my four-year-old son’s very first time fishing, and thanks to Andrew’s guidance, he caught his first salmon! It was such a special day — fun, relaxed, and full of excitement from start to finish. I can’t recommend Captain Andrew and King Tide Fishing Charters enough!

quotes.author: Dale D
quotes.text: We had a great day fishing with Captain Cam. The fishing was great. My grandsons really enjoyed catching multiple salmon and helping pull in the crab traps on our way back to the dock. We highly recommend Cam as your captain. ( remember to ask for him when booking your fishing trip. Feeding the seals at the dock with the fish guts was a highlight too!,,

quotes.author: Jody C
quotes.text: Captain Andrew took us out fishing for two full days to celebrate my father’s 80th birthday! We caught a halibut and six salmon. The boat was clean, organized and ran well. Andrew was helpful with everyone and knew the best fishing spots. His excitement each time we caught a fish matched ours. It was an amazing trip to be forever remembered.

quotes.author: Mary K
quotes.text: We can't recommend Captain Andrew and King Tide Fishing Charters highly enough!! He took 8 of us out for a wonderful morning on the water on Easter Sunday. It was such a treat to be fishing in an exceptional setting with a highly experienced guide. To top it all off, we saw sea lions and even a pod of orcas!!

quotes.author: Cameron B
quotes.text: Andrew is an exceptional guide with a wealth of knowledge experience and unreal setup in Sooke. We have an amazing day out with him with our group of 8. Could not recommend a better outfit in Sooke. Tons of wildlife including Orcas !!

quotes.author: N D
quotes.text: Captain Shane took us out and we had a great time! Caught a lot of fish and we were able to keep a few that Captain Shane fillet for us. The pricing was very reasonable and I highly recommend King Tide. Would definitely go again !
